in_marathi.name: Baliram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Strong as a Mountain, Rider of a Ram
in_marathi.long_meaning: Baliram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Baliram is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Bal' (strong, powerful) and 'Ram' (Rider of a Ram). The name suggests strength, power, and courage. In Hindu mythology, Baliram is an alternate name for Lord Hanuman, the monkey god known for his unwavering devotion and strength.
